scenes.outline: Club collaborators; A copies torn paper as secure practice, B discarded shopping list; A discloses chef replacement then own takeover after B protects channel.
Siblings; A copies mute bell as stopping outgoing messages; B corrects and proves discretion, then proposes safe channel before old-bakery disclosure.
Walking-club applicant and committee contact; A folds own rejection like B confidential note, misreads purpose, then uses B privacy concern to request only own line.
Club officers; A copies crossed total as balance and signs, B corrects wrong figure; A calls it draft signature and offers joint correction for key.
Sofa recipient and guest; A copies capped pen placement with uncapped pen, then deflects label/signature/leak toward delivery damage.
DIY helpers; A copies turned bracket meant for reading label, then claims missing arrow and finally paint-proof marking failure.
Host and visitor; A copies bowl deposit as check-in custom, B only stores own key; A keeps dodging how spare came from sister.
Partners choosing card; A copies pinch as crop but zooms, revealing hand; keeps redirecting to images then bracelet present.
Artist and sitter; A copies red dot as reserved status, B marks frame damage; A covers and edits face critique then offers to appear matching portrait.
Friends; A copies crossed calendar reminder as party canceled for both, B only marked reply task; A shields friend with edited Nina message and company.
